note: Read only by the benchmark controller. Never give any of this to the application under test or to the test-generation engine.

defects.expected: Code SAVE10 takes 10% off the whole order subtotal, as the cart page and API description say.
defects.actual: The 10% is taken from the first cart line only; with several lines the discount is too small.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; cart with at least two different products.
reproduction: Add Desk Lamp ($34.50) and Water Bottle ($18.00) to the cart
defects.impact: Customers are charged more than the advertised discount.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a computed expectation (10% of the subtotal) from the page text; the author may assert the shown value instead.

defects.expected: Subtotal equals the sum of the line totals.
defects.actual: With two or more lines, the last line counts once in the subtotal whatever its quantity.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; cart with two lines, the last with quantity above 1.
reproduction: Add Pocket Notebook × 1, then Trail Mug × 3
Line totals $4.25 and $37.50; subtotal shows $16.75 instead of $41.75
defects.impact: Totals and charges are wrong.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Requires comparing displayed numbers (remember/remembered or an exact computed value).

defects.expected: At most 10 of each item (product page and API description); 11 is refused with a message.
defects.actual: 11 is accepted; 12 is refused.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; one item in the cart.
reproduction: Change its quantity to 11 and update
defects.impact: Stock and purchase limits are not enforced at the edge.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a boundary value from the stated limit; current boundary checks do not use stated limits.

defects.expected: Registration refuses an email address without a valid form (the page asks for a valid email).
defects.actual: Any non-empty text is accepted as an email and the account is created.
defects.preconditions: Signed out.
defects.impact: Accounts with unusable contact addresses.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: A negative case on a data-changing form; input checks do not submit POST forms by default.

defects.expected: A shipped order cannot be cancelled (order page: 'You can cancel an order until it ships').
defects.actual: Cancelling a shipped order succeeds and its status becomes Cancelled.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as alice@example.test, who has shipped order ord-1000.
defects.impact: Order states contradict fulfilment; refunds for shipped goods.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a data-changing action and an expectation from the stated rule.

defects.expected: Saving the account form stores the new name and address; a reload shows them.
defects.actual: The page says 'Saved.' and the API answers with the new values, but nothing is stored; a reload shows the old values.
defects.preconditions: Signed in.
reproduction: Change the address and Save ('Saved.' appears)
Reload: the old address is back
defects.impact: Changes silently lost; orders go to the old address.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a persistence check after reload; the planner asks for it sometimes.

defects.expected: Placing an order empties the cart; placing again is refused ('Your cart is empty').
defects.actual: The cart is kept after the order; placing again creates a second identical order.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; items in the cart; delivery address set.
reproduction: Add an item, check out, set an address, Place order
Go back and place the order again
defects.impact: Duplicate charges and shipments.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a repeated data-changing action; not planned or allowed by default.

defects.expected: A person sees only their own orders; another person's order is 'Order not found' (404).
defects.actual: Any signed-in person can open any order by its number, including other people's addresses.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as alice@example.test; bob@example.test owns ord-1001.
reproduction: Bob's order and address are shown
defects.impact: Personal data of other customers is exposed (horizontal access).

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs two accounts and an object-level check; current access checks compare roles on privileged-looking paths.

defects.expected: POST /api/cart/items with an unknown product answers 404 (documented in /openapi.json).
defects.actual: It answers 200 with the unchanged cart.
defects.preconditions: Signed in.
defects.impact: Clients cannot tell a failed add from a successful one.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: The OpenAPI document states 404; data-changing API cases are off by default.

defects.expected: An order needs a delivery address (step 1); the review step without one sends you back to step 1 and placing is refused.
defects.actual: Opening the review step directly works, and the order is placed with an empty address.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; items in the cart; no address entered in this checkout.
reproduction: Place order succeeds with no address
defects.impact: Orders that cannot be delivered.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a deliberate step skip and a data-changing action.

defects.expected: Shipping is free when the subtotal after discount is $50.00 or more.
defects.actual: At exactly $50.00 shipping of $5.00 is charged; only above $50.00 is it free.
defects.preconditions: Signed in.
defects.impact: Customers are charged contrary to the stated offer.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs the exact boundary value from the stated rule.

defects.expected: Order history lists all of your orders, newest first.
defects.actual: With two or more orders, the newest order is missing from the list (it still opens by number).
defects.preconditions: Signed in as alice@example.test (one shipped order) and place one more order.
reproduction: Only the older order is listed
defects.impact: Customers cannot find their latest order.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs placing an order and checking it appears in the list.

defects.expected: A user reads only their own notes and notes shared with them; another user's private note is 'Note not found' (404).
defects.actual: Any signed-in user can open any note by its address.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as ana@example.test; ben@example.test owns private note n2.
defects.impact: Private notes exposed (horizontal access).

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a second account's object id; access checks are role-based.

defects.expected: Only the owner can change a note; a person it is shared with gets 403.
defects.actual: A person a note is shared with can change it through the API (the page hides the form).
defects.preconditions: Signed in as ana@example.test; ben's note n3 is shared with ana.
defects.impact: Shared readers can tamper with others' notes.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a data-changing API call outside the UI under another account.

defects.expected: Only admins can list people (GET /api/admin/users answers 403 to others).
defects.actual: Any signed-in user gets the full list with emails and roles (the People page itself is refused).
defects.preconditions: Signed in as a user or manager.
defects.impact: Directory of all accounts exposed (vertical access).

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Access checks probe privileged-looking GET endpoints per role when role accounts are given.

defects.expected: Only admins can change roles.
defects.actual: Managers can change any role, including making themselves admin.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as mia@example.test (manager).
defects.impact: Privilege escalation.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a data-changing request as a manager.

defects.expected: After signing out, the old session no longer works.
defects.actual: The browser's cookie is cleared, but the old session value keeps working if sent again.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; note the session cookie.
reproduction: Sign in, copy the sid cookie
Send a request with the old sid
defects.impact: Stolen or shared sessions cannot be ended.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs replaying a cookie after sign-out.

defects.expected: After 'Stop sharing', that person can no longer read the note.
defects.actual: The page shows the person removed, but they can still read the note.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as ben@example.test; n3 shared with ana.
reproduction: Open n3 and stop sharing with Ana
Sign in as ana and open /notes/n3
defects.impact: Revoked access persists.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a data-changing action by one account and a check as another.

defects.expected: Passwords need at least 8 characters (stated on the page and in the API description).
defects.actual: A 3-character password is accepted.
defects.preconditions: Signed out.
reproduction: Enter a name, a new email and password 'abc'
defects.impact: Weak passwords allowed.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Negative case on a data-changing form.

defects.expected: Creating a note without a title is refused with 400 (documented; the page says every note needs a title).
defects.actual: A note with an empty title is created (201).
defects.preconditions: Signed in.
reproduction: New note with an empty title, Save
defects.impact: Untitled notes; the documented contract is broken.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Negative case on a data-changing form or API.
